objects.name: seq_admin_users
objects.content:
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS divingapp.seq_admin_users
    INCREMENT BY 1
    START WITH 2
    MINVALUE 1
    NO CYCLE;
conversion_notes: Oracle MAXVALUE 9999999999999999999999999999 exceeds PostgreSQL bigint range; omitted MAXVALUE
Oracle NOCACHE/NOORDER/NOKEEP/NOSCALE/GLOBAL have no direct PostgreSQL equivalent; not applied
